alignments.note: Coordinating conjunction rendered by the verse-opening *and*.
Imperative rendered by the bare *make*. Rule 17's *make straight* head on *straight* does not apply, since the Greek expresses the adjective separately as s003 and rule 2 leaves each its own word.
Anarthrous plural noun rendered by the bare *paths*.

Rule 20: the genitive pronoun s007 is free and takes the English possessive *your*, so the article's determiner slot is occupied and it realizes nothing. The dative's case preposition *for* therefore stays with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause, which forbids leaving a bare *for* on the article.
The noun takes the discontinuous *for … feet*, the supplied preposition realizing the dative case per rule 21; rule 15 permits the discontinuity across the possessive.
Genitive pronoun rendered by the possessive *your*, displacing the article's determiner under rule 20.
Purpose conjunction realized by the word introducing its English clause, the first *that* (rule 40).

Substantival article with an adjectival complement and no participle following, so rule 22 rather than rule 32 applies: it takes the whole *that which*. Rule 77 records that a substantival article rendered *that which* heads on *that* in all nine corpus units.
The substantival article's complement is an adjective, and the Greek clause is verbless, so the supplied copula *is* rides with the adjectival predicate under rule 53, headed on the lexical *lame*.
Ordinary negative rendered by *not*; no negative indefinite stands with it, so rules 41 and 59 are not in question.

The passive subjunctive takes its auxiliary *be* and the whole English idiom *turned out of the way*, headed on the lexical *turned* under rules 9 and 17. *out of the way* is this verb's own English expression rather than a preposition phrase answering to any source token; the alternative_rendering note's *put out of joint* is the same shape. Rule 15 permits the discontinuity across the intervening *not*, which is s009's.
Passive subjunctive with its auxiliary; rule 9 heads on the lexical *healed*.

review_notes: Every s### and t### is partitioned exactly once; t001–t023 and s001–s015 all accounted for.

s005 is the only unrepresented unit. A reference comparison may report it as a disagreement, but rule 20 is explicit: the free genitive s007 takes *your*, so the article realizes nothing and the case preposition *for* rides with the noun under rule 21 rather than being left as a bare *for* on the article.

The competing reading for s012 would split *out of the way* off as a separate locative unit, but no source token answers to it — it is part of the ASV's rendering of ἐκτρέπομαι, as the verse's own alternative_rendering *put out of joint* shows.
Variant SBLGNT.HEB.12.13.v006 is underdetermined over s004 and carries no FALLBACK EXCLUDED mark, so rule 97 does not apply and no textual decision is made here (rule 12).
